summary: Covers airlines providing passenger air transportation worldwide, including full-service, low-cost and regional carriers. Disclosure topics are greenhouse gas emissions, labour practices, competitive behaviour, and accident and safety management.

questions.text: What are your organisation's gross global Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) CO2-e · Report gross global Scope 1 emissions for the reporting period, in metric tonnes CO2-e, covering direct emissions from sources you own or control.

questions.text: How does your organisation plan to manage its Scope 1 emissions over the short and long term, including any reduction targets and how you have performed against them?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe your short- and long-term strategy or plan, the emissions reduction targets, and an analysis of performance against those targets.

questions.text: What is your (1) total fuel consumed, (2) percentage alternative fuel and (3) percentage sustainable fuel?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total fuel in gigajoules (GJ), then (2) the percentage alternative and (3) the percentage sustainable.

questions.text: What percentage of your active workforce is employed under collective agreements?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the percentage of active employees covered by collective bargaining or collective agreements.

questions.text: How many work stoppages did your organisation experience, and how many total days were idle as a result?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Days idle · Report (1) the number of work stoppages and (2) the total days idle, for the reporting period.

questions.text: What is the total amount of monetary losses your organisation incurred as a result of legal proceedings associated with anti-competitive behaviour regulations?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses for the period in your presentation currency, covering fines, settlements and other legal costs from such proceedings.

questions.text: How has your organisation implemented a Safety Management System, and what have been the outcomes?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how the Safety Management System is implemented (scope, governance, key processes) and its outcomes, such as improvements in safety performance.

questions.text: How many aviation accidents did your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total count for the reporting period.

questions.text: How many governmental enforcement actions of aviation safety regulations did your organisation face?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of enforcement actions taken by governmental authorities under aviation safety regulations.

questions.text: What are your available seat kilometres (ASK)?
questions.hint: Unit: ASK · Report available seat kilometres (ASK) for the reporting period.

questions.text: What is your passenger load factor?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report the passenger load factor as a rate (typically RPK divided by ASK) and state how it is calculated.

questions.text: What are your revenue passenger kilometres (RPK)?
questions.hint: Unit: RPK · Report revenue passenger kilometres (RPK) for the reporting period.
Unit: RTK · Report revenue tonne-kilometres for the reporting period.

questions.text: How many departures did your organisation operate?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of departures in the reporting period.

questions.text: What is the average age of your fleet?
questions.hint: Unit: Years · Report the average fleet age in years.
